_comment: Traditional Chinese texts for the German table fan_burrow. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_TW.

strings.A crack in the rock opens into a dry hol: 岩石上的一道裂縫通向一個乾燥的洞穴。
